title: What is Amazon Translate?
description: Amazon Translate is a neural machine translation service that delivers fast, high-quality, affordable, and customizable language translation.

title: User Guide — Digital Translation Service
description: This service allows approved Users to upload documents for translation across up to 75 languages. Translation quality varies by language — widely used Latin-based languages such as English, French, and Spanish tend to produce more accurate results, while languages such as Arabic, Urdu, and Somali may require additional review by a bilingual colleague or native speaker. This tool must NOT be used for medication instructions, health and safety guidance, legal documents, or complex documents that cannot be simplified. A mandatory disclaimer must be added to all translated documents before distribution. A cost centre code is required for cross-charging. For more information, please consult the full guide.
